posts.caption:
How much a month to retire a millionaire? I tested every start month since 1928.

669 people. Each one invests the same amount every month for 40 years in the S&P 500.

$100 a month: not one of them gets there.
$300 a month: 106 of 669. About one in six.
$500 a month: 452 of 669. Two out of three.
$788 a month: every single one.

The hardest start was August 1942. The person who started in September 1929, one month before the crash, only needed $256.

The median was $420. Not a fortune. A habit.

Adjusted for inflation to 2023 dollars, dividends reinvested. Robert Shiller's S&P 500 data, 1871 to 2023. Not financial advice.
